latest_release.body:
## Updates:
- #2188: Added an SFPEW compatibility layer switch for MobileGlues (by @MovTery)

## Changes:
- #2188: Adjusted the position of the reset button in the renderer config dialog (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- #2188: Fixed MobileGlues config display not matching what actually takes effect (by @MovTery)
- #2187: Physical mouse button clicks not working on some devices (by @mvanhorn)
- #2194: Flaw in the modpack export filtering mechanism, resulting in possibly incomplete exported files (by @MovTery)
- #2195: Incorrect list height on the Java management screen, causing abnormal background rendering (by @MovTery)
- #2199: Crash on Android 8.x due to text being created and copied off the main thread (by @MovTery)
- #2204: Actively sync SDL gamepad device enumeration, fixing Controlify requiring a gamepad reconnect before passthrough works (by @MovTery)
- #2205: Local cache of server icons never updates (by @MovTery)
- #2206: The disabled state of the original file is now preserved when updating mods (by @MovTery)
